anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.banne: You were severed from this devil. It will never sign with you again.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.alrea: You already hold a contract with this devil.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.full: This devil already has all the contracts it will give (%s). Nobody can join until one ends.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.one_o: You already hold a devil contract. A mage holds one on this server.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.weak_: You hold as many devils as one body can carry (%s).
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.stron: You hold the most Supreme devils one body can carry (%s).
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.ep_st: A second Supreme devil asks far more of you. Your existence points: %s. It asks: %s.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.deny.ep: The devil will not answer one so small. Your existence points: %s. It asks: %s.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.summon.fai: %s does not answer. The circle goes cold. (It answers about one call in %s. Carrying something of it raises the odds.)
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.summon.rel: %s answers. What you carry of it drew it in. (%s percent)
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.trial.star: %s will not sign with the weak. It steps out of the circle to try you. Impress it, or beat it.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.trial.no_r: %s cannot take shape here (no room, or too many trials are running). The ritual is spent.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.betray.vic: %s turns on the circle. It strikes you down: it was never yours to call.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.betray.cal: %s turns on everyone in the circle but you. (%s struck)
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.confirm.ti: %s offers a contract. Read the terms before you sign:
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.confirm.on: %s is one of a kind: it has no other contract. You would be its only holder.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.confirm.co: %s already has %s of %s contracts. After you join it has %s, and its power is split evenly between them.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.confirm.ep: Your existence points: %s. This contract asks: %s (a dominance contract: %s).
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.kind.submi: Submission: you serve it. You get %s percent of its power; the creeping corruption of its price grows half as fast.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.kind.even: Even: a pact of equals, 50-50. You get %s percent of its power.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.kind.domin: Dominance: you overpower it and take what it has. You get %s percent of its power.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.kind.hover: The price is taken at once and stays through death.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.why.not_wo: beat the devil in the trial first
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.why.ep_dom: your existence points are too low for it
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.why.no_tri: this devil does not fight, so it cannot be overpowered
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.why.ep: your existence points are too low
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.confirm.wa: If another holder of this devil kills you, your contract is severed for good. If you kill a fellow holder you are cursed for %s seconds: your devil's power drops to %s percent.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.explain.1: A devil answers a ritual only sometimes, more often when you carry something of it. It may turn on the others in the circle. It asks for existence points (EP): the higher its rank, the more.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.explain.2: Some devils fight you first. Impress them (bring them to half health) to sign an even or a submission contract. Beat them to try to dominate them.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.explain.3: Submission: a quarter of its power, safer. Even: half. Dominance: all of it, but only if you beat it and your EP is far above its own.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.explain.4: Supreme devils are one of a kind: one holder in the world. Every lesser devil is shared: the more contracts it has, the less each holder gets (four contracts: a quarter each).
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.explain.5: You may hold many lesser devils, but only one is active at a time (/devil pact use). A second Supreme devil asks five times the EP, a third more, and two is the most.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.explain.6: A holder who kills another holder of the same shared devil cuts that contract for good, and is cursed for a few minutes. Hitting fellow holders over and over costs the same curse.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.choose.no: That contract is not possible for you now. Read the terms again (/devil sign).
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.joined.oth: Another player signed with %s. It has %s contracts now: your share of its power is %s percent.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.joined.you: You signed a %s contract. You hold %s percent of the power of %s.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.joined.sta: %s is held but not active: your active devil stays. /devil pact use %s swaps (once a minute).
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.use.off: Devil contracts of phase 2 are off on this server.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.use.not_he: You hold no contract with that devil (/devil pact list).
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.use.same: That devil is already your active one.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.use.busy: Push the devil back first: you cannot swap while it is let in or in the union.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.use.cooldo: You swapped a moment ago. Wait a minute.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.list.none: You hold no contract with a devil of the roster.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.list.curse: You are cursed: your devil's power is cut for %s more seconds.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.sever.vict: %s killed you. Your contract with %s is severed for good: it will never sign with you again.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.sever.kill: You cut %s from %s. Your share of it grows.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.sabotage.f: You keep striking your fellow holders. The devil punishes it: your power is cut to %s percent for %s seconds.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.sabotage.s: Cutting a bond has a price. The devil curses you: your power is cut to %s percent for %s seconds.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.pact.taken: That pact devil already has a holder on this server.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.trial.won: You beat %s. It kneels. A dominance contract is possible now, if your existence points allow it.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.trial.impr: %s is impressed. "Enough." It offers a contract. Keep fighting if you want to beat it and take all of its power.
anime_multiverse.devil.phase2.trial.left: %s is not impressed. It leaves. The ritual is spent.
